en: The Philippine Senate has exactly 24 members, whereas the House of Representatives contains over 300 district representatives.
Jose Rizal wrote two famous novels, whereas his contemporary Marcelo H. del Pilar authored over 150 political essays.
If laid end to end, the Ifugao Banaue Rice Terraces would stretch over 20,000 kilometers, halfway around the Earth.
The Philippines has over 180 distinct languages, but only Filipino and English serve as the two official national languages.
The Philippine eagle boasts a wingspan of up to two meters, much wider than the one-meter wingspan of common hawks.
Dr. Fe del Mundo invented a bamboo incubator that costs 90 percent less than standard electric incubators for rural clinics.
The Katipunan secret society grew from just seven original founders in 1892 to over 30,000 members by the 1896 revolution.
The longest Filipino film runs for 615 minutes, which is over ten hours longer than a standard two-hour movie.
Cebu's Sinulog Festival draws over one million attendees, vastly outnumbering the few thousand visitors at smaller local town fiestas.
The 1987 Philippine Constitution has 18 articles, while the shorter 1973 Constitution originally contained only 17 articles.
The traditional Bayanihan practice requires an entire barangay of 50 to 100 volunteers to carry a single nipa hut.
The Philippines declared independence from Spain in 1898, exactly 48 years before finally gaining independence from America in 1946.
